facts.text: Carleton operates on a trimester system of three 10-week terms: fall, winter, and spring.

sources.title: Fun Facts about the Trimester System – Carleton Admissions
sources.quote: The trimester system means three terms made up of 10 weeks each, one in the Fall (September-November), Winter (January-March), and Spring (March-June).

facts.text: All students must complete a senior integrative exercise, known as comps, to graduate.

sources.title: Comps Program – Chemistry - Carleton College
sources.quote: A unique graduation requirement of all Carleton students is the integrative exercise, also known on campus as “comps.”
